source: Project Operating System Phase 4 - Validation Engine
description: Declarative compliance rules for future validation decisions.

rules.description: Testing approval must exist before a component can be validated.
Migration approval is required when the component is linked to a migration.
All required checklist items must pass or have accepted manual review.
No critical nonconformity may remain open.
Manual approval must be recorded before approval.
Recurring behavior should be controlled by configuration before code.
POS records must not become the source of legal or labor knowledge.
Primary question, secondary questions and reader action must resolve the declared search intent.
Blocker plain-language, flow, example or repetition findings must be resolved.
Update sensitivity and mutable content must be classified without invented dates.
Official-dependent claims require verified source traceability.
Domain, nucleus, cluster, pillar and article role must be resolved without inventing a cluster.
Typed outbound links must be relevant, descriptive and target existing assets.
Inbound-link action and orphan risk must be explicitly resolved.
Existing articles remain LEGACY_ACCEPTED_PENDING_MIGRATION unless retrofit is explicitly approved.
Guide assets, category pages and NUCLEUS_ARTICLE_SECTION must keep distinct roles; isolated Guide cards on Home are forbidden.
One deduplicated and deterministically ordered governed collection must feed mobile and desktop.
Mobile is a horizontal carousel with at most six visible cards; desktop is a grid with at most nine.
A nucleus without eligible published articles must not render a public Home section.
The first calculator registers a candidate only; the first article may provision when unambiguous; future articles reuse the section; ambiguity requires manual decision.

notes: Rules define compliance decisions and do not enforce them automatically.
